description: 把一个业务的现行逻辑写成需求文档 REQ-NNN (docs/sdd/req/), 内容是当前功能的结论: 逐条编号的 FR / BR / AC, 状态机与规则表, 数据影响, 代码落点. 当用户说 "把 XX 的业务逻辑整理 / 收集 / 写下来", "这个功能现在是怎么工作的, 记成文档", "建个 REQ", "先收集旧逻辑", 或 /create-cr 发现目标业务没有 REQ 时使用. 也用于给全新业务写目标形态的 REQ (状态 draft). 不写代码.

name: req
description: オーナーの一言から対話で要件を固め、テンプレ準拠の GitHub issue を作る (完了条件・実機確認の観点まで)。「OK」で着手ラベル (pv:ready) を付け、次の sweep が着手する。ローカル / クラウドどちらでも動く

name: req
description: docs/requirements/ 에서 요구사항을 검색하거나 특정 ID의 상세 내용을 조회

name: req
description: Use when the user wants to create a development-requirements document interactively, or when the user invokes /req (with or without arguments). Activates on natural-language requests like "draft a requirements doc" in addition to the slash command.

name: req-add
description: Mint a new REQ ID in the Assured project's namespace, with module assignment, and append it to the requirements-spec.

name: req-analysis
description: 需求分析 — 需求拆解、用户故事编写、验收标准定义。当用户提出新需求、需要编写 PRD、拆解功能点或定义优先级与验收标准时使用。

name: req-analyze
description: Requirements analysis — problem decomposition, stakeholder scan, requirement structuring. Produces 1-requirements.md (Phase 1 lifecycle doc, NOT the per-task request ticket — for those use /create-request). Use when: analyzing needs before tech spec, decomposing requirements, stakeholder analysis, 需求分析. Not for: solution comparison (use feasibility-study), tech design (use tech-spec), per-task tracking tickets (use create-request), issue root cause (use issue-analyze).
allowed_tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(git:*), Bash(node:*), Bash(bash:*), Write, Agent, Skill, AskUserQuestion, WebSearch, WebFetch

name: req-analyzer
description: 根据需求文档或截图分析需求，结合本地代码库给出结构化的修改方案及步骤流程。此 Skill 应在用户提供了需求文档（Word/PDF/Markdown/纯文本）、需求截图、或描述了功能变更需求时触发。触发关键词包括：需求分析、分析需求、需求文档、需求变更、需求改代码、看看需求、截图分析、栖图需求、analyze requirement、requirement analysis、req change、需求修改方案、改代码方案、根据需求改代码、根据文档改代码。

name: req-api-client
description: Use when building an HTTP API client, SDK wrapper, or service integration module in Elixir using the Req library. Triggers on "API client", "SDK", "service wrapper", "HTTP integration", "webhook", "Req plugin", or when creating modules that call external APIs.

name: req-assess
description: Analyze interview transcripts against the agent-aligned engineering standard. Update skill and behaviour ratings with observed evidence. Produces per-interview assessments and panel briefs for later interview stages. Use when transcript files appear in a candidate's folder.

name: req-audit
description: Audit one module for defects that live BETWEEN requirements - overlapping state, missing error precedence, untested dependencies, dead REQs. Read-only, returns a list of suspects. Use when the user asks to audit, review as a whole, or sanity-check a module's requirements.

name: req-brainstorm
description: Use when the user wants to brainstorm a development request through active proposals before producing a requirements document, or when the user invokes /req-brainstorm. Activates on natural-language phrases like "壁打ちしてから要件書を作りたい" or "ブレストして要件にまとめて" in addition to the slash command.

name: req-bundle
description: Split a Workday CV-bundle PDF into per-candidate CV.pdf files under 2-Confidential/Candidates/. Reads the PDF outline (one bookmark per candidate) to find each candidate's page range, matches it to the requisition roster so folder names agree with req-workday, and extracts each CV losslessly. Use when the user provides a Workday CV bundle (a large combined resume PDF, often split into `_N_of_M` parts) and asks to split, unbundle, or extract individual CVs — run this before req-workday imports the roster.

name: req-change
description: 需求变更管理。在规范/设计/编码完成后需求发生变更时，进行影响分析和增量调整。 输入：变更描述 + 目标需求 ID 输出：orch-spec/{req_id}/changelogs/change-{ts}.md + 更新后的 spec/design/tasks TRIGGER when: requirement changes after spec/design/code are complete, needing impact analysis.

name: req-change-workflow
description: 已有功能的需求变更闭环（门禁式七步）。触发硬条件：要改的功能已经实现并跑起来了。当用户说"改需求""需求变更""调整交互""改功能""重构流程"，或改动容易散到多个文件、碰到鉴权/存储/配置/权限、需要可靠验证 + 回滚方案时使用。流程：锁 scope 写 change brief → 从代码确认当前行为（不靠记忆和假设）→ 影响面与风险评估 + 回滚计划 → 提出新设计等用户批准（**未获批准绝不动代码**）→ 小而局部的 diff → 跑固定回归清单 → 更新文档和决策日志。产出：change brief + 代码 diff + 回归记录 + decision log。不适用于：全新功能从零做（走 issue-pool → page-solution-design（有界面时）→ backend-logic-design（有规则需讨论时）→ prd-test-writer）、只改视觉样式不动任何逻辑（按已有界面直接调整）、新想法还没定要不要做（先用 issue-pool 入池）、写 PRD/测试用例（用 prd-test-writer）、提交推送发版（用 git-push）。注意：本 skill 的七步流程通用于任何项目，但 scripts/impact_scan.sh 与 references/chrome-extension-regression-example.md 是…

name: req-change-workflow
description: Standardize requirement/feature changes in an existing codebase (especially Chrome extensions) by turning "改需求/需求变更/调整交互/改功能/重构流程" into a repeatable loop: clarify acceptance criteria, confirm current behavior from code, assess impact/risk, design the new logic, implement with small diffs, run a fixed regression checklist, and update docs/decision log. Use when the user feels the change process is chaotic, when edits tend to sprawl across files, or when changes touch manifest/service worker/OAuth/storage/UI and need reliable verification + rollback planning.

name: req-check
description: 检查项目需求的工具 skill。当用户要求"检查项目信息""项目检查""项目描述检查""项目需求检查"，或检查/审查项目需求、检查项目描述文件（memory 下 pro_xxx/PROJECT.md）是否合规、需求是否明确、模块功能是否清晰时使用（配合顺序：先 init-mem 验形式合规，再本 skill 验内容质量）。输出合规/缺口清单，逐项向用户澄清需求与模块功能，确认后给出修正建议（不直接修改描述文件）。

name: req-coverage-audit
description: Auditiert pro REQ-, NFR- und UI-NFR-Dokument die Coverage. Pro REQ: Backend (API/Service/Engine/Repo/Models), Frontend (Pages/Redux/i18n), Tests (E2E + Backend Unit + Frontend Vitest), Spec-Drift (Versionen, Cross-Refs, MEMORY.md). Pro NFR/UI-NFR: erwartete Artefakte (Configs/Tools/Patterns), Validierung (Tests/CI/Hooks), Drift. Erzeugt persistentes Audit-Artefakt unter .audits/req-coverage-audit.md mit Coverage-Score je Anforderung und priorisierter Handlungsliste. Nutze diesen Skill periodisch oder vor einem Release fuer eine vollstaendige Coverage-Bilanz; ohne Argument werden alle REQ+NFR+…

name: req-create
description: Create structured requirement documents from user ideas. Use when capturing new features, tasks, or user stories

name: req-create
description: Create an IEC 62304 software requirement from a feature description or code change.

name: req-decide
description: Synthesize all evidence (CV screening, interview assessments, transcripts) into a final hiring recommendation. Produces a comprehensive recommendation document with full evidence trail, level/track/discipline confirmation, and a clear hire/no-hire decision. Use when all interview stages are complete.

name: req-decompose
description: Decompose a product-phase directory (requirements.md + architecture.md) into GitHub issues, one per requirement. Supports "scan", "create", and "status".

name: req-decomposer
description: 复杂业务需求自动拆解与方案建模专家。在面对庞大、模糊或复杂的业务需求，需要产出模块拆解方案、编写开发 Spec 任务书或厘清各子模块依赖时，加载此技能。

name: req-design
description: 为已排期的需求做方案：列至少两个选项、写决策记录、评估波及面（blast radius）、定验收检查点，全部落进需求文档。Use when a requirement is scheduled and before implementation, or when someone asks 方案怎么定 / 这个改动会影响哪些地方.

name: req-dev-lite
description: Requirements-interrogation agent, local lightweight edition (no issue tracker). Trigger when the user says "grill my requirements", "review my requirements (local)", "local PRD", "req-dev lite", "pre-PRD", or "/req-dev-lite". Orchestrates grill-with-docs and layers Mom Test / Impact Mapping / 5 Whys / Specification by Example / Cockburn Extensions / INVEST / Volere QG on top, producing a local markdown PRD (with an Open Items section). Unlike the full req-dev, it creates no GitHub issues and needs no gh CLI. Chinese version: SKILL.zh.md (same folder)

name: req-discovery
description: เก็บและวิเคราะห์ requirement อย่างเป็นระบบ — ระบุ stakeholder, เลือกเทคนิค elicitation, แปลงความต้องการดิบเป็น user story + acceptance criteria แล้วจัดลำดับด้วย MoSCoW เป็น product backlog (Elicit, analyze and prioritize requirements into a ready-to-build backlog). Trigger เมื่อผู้ใช้พิมพ์ /req-discovery หรือขอ "เก็บ requirement / สัมภาษณ์ผู้ใช้ / user story / backlog / requirement gathering / elicitation".

name: req-discovery
description: 需求发掘与 User Story 生成。通过多轮结构化访谈，将模糊的产品想法转化为完整的 User Story 列表（含 Given/When/Then 验收标准和 MoSCoW 优先级），可选择直接衔接 /feature-fullstack 进入实施。 Use when the user says: "发掘需求" / "需求访谈" / "帮我写 user story" / "整理需求" / "/req-discovery" "我有个功能想法" / "帮我梳理需求" / "把需求整理成 story" / "我想做 X 功能" "需求不清楚" / "怎么把想法变成可以开发的需求" / "帮我拆功能" Always trigger this skill whenever the user has a vague feature idea that needs to become concrete, implementable requirements — even when they don't say "user story" or "requirements" explicitly.

name: req-doc-writer
description: 需求文档撰写技能。从资料分析→初稿撰写(直接写精简版)→多轮自审自改→交付确认的完整流程。 核心理念：初稿即精简，不做"先复杂再精简"的绕路。 适用于：业务需求文档、产品需求文档（PRD）、AI场景需求文档等。 触发词：写需求文档、撰写需求、需求文档初稿、PRD、写需求。

name: req-done
description: Close out the current requirement. Runs CI, maps each criterion to a tagged test, and updates PROGRESS.md and COVERAGE.md with evidence.

name: req-elicit
description: Turn a loose description of features — an idea file in docs/ideas/ or a few paragraphs in chat — into reviewed, approved FLOWs and REQs, asking the user only about gaps and conflicts. Use this whenever the user wants to formalize, specify or scope an idea, a feature list or a rough spec, or turn it into requirements, even if they do not name the skill.

name: req-elicit
description: Collaborative Requirements Elicitation through Discovery Dialogue. Use when: (1) User provides vague feature requirements, (2) Starting new feature/project, (3) User says "I want to build", "I need a feature", (4) Before generating CL12 contracts, (5) When requirements have high ambiguity that would produce theater contracts, (6) Refactoring legacy code that lacks contracts (Constitutional Refactoring). Triggers: "elicit requirements", "gather requirements", "I want to build", "help me specify", "what are the requirements", "clarify requirements", "constitutional refactoring". Output: REQUIRE…

name: req-elicitation
description: Structured requirements elicitation — derive complete, verifiable requirements from stakeholder goals (IEEE 29148, IREB, EARS). Use when: elicit requirements, gather requirements, what are the requirements, new product requirements, user needs, stakeholder goals, write PRD, requirements from scratch.

name: req-engineer
description: Interviews the user conversationally, researches supplied website URLs and reference documents, stress-tests answers, and produces requirements.md with visual prototypes (ASCII wireframes, CLI examples, API samples). Use for requirements, PRDs, product specs, project scoping, website or product references, competitor links, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, user stories, acceptance criteria, and project planning.

name: req-eval
description: 需求评估器——按项目类型用不同"镜头"评估一个需求/项目能不能做、值不值得做、报价合不合理。覆盖四类：①外包需求类（接单/甲方付费，重点：范围边界+验收可测性+报价合理性+合同风险）②项目合作类（合伙/共建/分成，重点：权责分工+利益分配+退出机制）③自研商业产品（自己做来卖，重点：真伪需求+市场竞品+商业模式+MVP+ROI）④实用小工具类（自用/小范围提效，重点：有无现成替代+工时+最小实现）。触发条件：用户说"评估这个需求""这个需求能不能做""值不值得做""报价合不合理""项目可行性""接不接这个项目""需求清不清楚""范围边界在哪里"，或明说"外包/接单/甲方付费""合作/合伙/共建/分成/股权""自研/做产品/创业/SaaS/卖钱""小工具/脚本/自动化/提效"并要求评估/分析/报价/可行性判断。产出默认 Markdown 快评（分段+表格），加 --word 联动 word-doc 技能出正式 Word，加 --brief 只要一页结论。严格遵循 CLAUDE.md 推理校验规则：结论前先列前提、重要结论自我反驳一次、标注置信度、不确定先问不瞎猜。

name: req-experiment-handoff
description: 用于把 knowledge/experiment-plan/ 的 P4 实验规划转成 req-suite 下一棒 prompt，要求拆 TASK-EXP-* 并绑定 verifier。不用于亲自创建任务文件。

name: req-fault-tolerance
description: Analisa requisitos de software e injeta resiliência em código — do recebimento da tarefa (input) até a geração do artefato (build). Focado em mapear criticidade, exceções e fallbacks em cada etapa da execução.

name: req-forget
description: Process GDPR Article 17 data erasure requests. Finds and removes all personal data related to a named individual from the knowledge base, cached data, and agent state files. Use when the user receives a right-to-be-forgotten request, asks to delete all data about a person, or must comply with a data erasure obligation.

name: req-gameplay
description: 【内部Skill·仅限编排层调用】为PW项目生成玩法策划需求文档。本Skill仅由 requirement-generation 编排层或 design-review 确认设计后调度使用，不响应用户的直接调用请求。覆盖玩法策划文档的完整规格：玩法循环定义、玩法元素逐一拆解、操作限制与恢复配对、成败判定、蓝图定义、场景种植方案和美术资源参考。适用于大世界挑战、解谜玩法、限时试炼、收集活动、骑乘挑战、对战玩法等体验驱动型功能的需求文档生成。

name: req-gap-check
description: Scan all source files and report which have no linked requirement.

name: req-gather
description: Notion 기획 문서(MCP)와 사용자와의 대화에서 요구사항을 도출해 docs/requirements.md에 REQ ID·인수 기준·출처와 미결 질문으로 정리한다. "요구사항 정리", "Notion 기획서 읽어", "요구사항 뽑아줘" 요청에 쓴다.

name: req-http-client
description: Use when making HTTP requests from Elixir applications. Invoke before integrating external APIs. Covers Req setup, request patterns, error handling, retries, timeouts, and testing with Req.Test. Req is the modern HTTP client for Elixir, replacing HTTPoison and Tesla. Trigger words: Req, HTTP client, HTTP request, API integration, external API, HTTPoison replacement.

name: req-ids
description: Assign stable REQ-NNN ids in the spec — sole authority for REQ format, id allocation, and supersede markers. Invoked by /refine and /requirement, or run directly. Run under Opus.

name: req-init
description: docs/02-requirements/01-requirements.md と関連ファイル群の雛形を生成する。既存ファイルがあれば上書きしない。

name: req-intake
description: 在需求刚提出时，先挑战它是否该做，写下一条能验证的预期效果，再用模板建飞书需求文档和飞书项目（Meegle）工作项，两边互相链接。Use when someone raises a product or technical requirement, says 提需求 / 我想要 / 能不能加, or before any requirement work starts without a doc and a work item.

name: req-leveldesign
description: 【内部Skill·仅限编排层调用】为PW项目生成关卡策划需求文档。本Skill仅由 requirement-generation 编排层或 design-review 确认设计后调度使用，不响应用户的直接调用请求。覆盖关卡策划文档的完整规格：Boss战副本规则、战斗遭遇设计、技能规格集成、场景布局量化、演出Sequencer需求和多人机制定义。适用于野外Boss、高塔/秘域副本、日常洞窟副本、Boss捕获流程、关卡白盒设计、狂暴Boss/世界Boss等战斗驱动型内容的需求文档生成。Boss战斗设计本身（技能列表、阶段定义）由 workflow-caveboss Skill 负责。

name: req-link
description: Add a satisfies link from a DES → REQ, TEST → REQ/DES, or CODE annotation → ID, validating that the target exists in the registry.

name: req-lite
description: Use when the user wants to draft a requirements document for a lightweight Web maintenance task (text changes, image swaps, single-line copy edits) with minimal interview, or when the user invokes /req-lite. Activates on natural-language phrases like "軽い修正の要件書を作って" or "文言変更の依頼書をまとめて" in addition to the slash command.

name: req-llm-adapter
description: Goal: Give agents a compact, provider-agnostic recipe for using `req_llm` in BEAM projects (OpenCode/Serena/Codex). Keep opt-in and align with `docs/req_llm.md`.

name: req-loop
description: 要求確定のループを 1 周（= レビュー会 1 回分）進める。正本リポジトリの Q&A 表を読み、前回のレビュー会でもらった回答を仕様に反映し、未決定事項を選択肢と提案側の推奨（理由つき。推せないなら理由）付きの質問として起票し、レビュー会用の PPTX（今回の会で決めたい最大 3 問を表紙の次に出す）を生成して、利用者の回答待ちで止まる。v1 で要求がまだ無いとき（requirements/ にファイルが無く決定表も無いとき）と利用者が求めたときは、先に初回ヒアリング（1 回に最大 3 問・選択肢を付けずに業務の前提・判断の基準・優先順位を聞き、利用者が「十分」と言ったら終える）を行い、利用者が明示したことを要求と決定表の骨組みに、決まっていないことを Q&A 表の質問に落とす。利用者が持ち込んだ動くコード（PR・ブランチ・ディレクトリ）を渡されたら、読むだけで写して要求・業務ルール・暗黙の前提を Q&A 表の質問の候補（コードの該当箇所と「コードではこうなっていた」つき・回答待ち）として起票し、既存の正本との食い違いを挙げる（コードをマージせず、正本にもしない）。回答をスキルが推測で埋めることはしない。再開点は会話ではなく Q&A 表の状態から読むので、別セッションで呼び直しても続きから始まる。要求を最初に聞き取りたい・要求仕様の未決定事項を洗い出したい・レビュー会の資料を作…

name: req-merger
description: 合并需求问题答案，生成完备需求

name: req-new
description: Create a Requirement spec. Use when adding a new feature, "I want to spec out X", "new feature request", "create REQ for this", or when ready to formalize a feature idea. Do NOT use for creating tasks (use task-new instead) or bulk importing from PRD (use prd-import instead).

name: req-new
description: Create a new requirement compliant with the repo methodology from an informal description. Use when the user asks to add, create or draft a new requirement.

name: req-outcome
description: 上线后对照 intake 写下的预期效果收集证据，判断是否达成；没达成就写清差距和下一步；只有拿到证据才关闭需求。Use after the observation window of a shipped requirement, when someone asks 这个需求效果怎么样 / 可以关了吗, or before closing a work item.

name: req-parser
description: 解析原始需求文档为 Markdown

name: req-plan
description: >根据PRD制作SD计划

name: req-plan
description: 规格（Spec）→ 概要设计计划 —— SDD 流水线的 Plan 阶段。根据 PRD（纯规格）制定 SD （概要设计/System Design）级别的模块化开发计划——产出系统架构设计、模块职责分解、接口契约定义、 数据流设计。模块按依赖序划分→独立验收→最终组装；每个模块须声明它实现的 US（需求 ID）， 形成 US→M 追溯。硬约束直接引用 .claude/skills/_shared/constitution.md，不自行发明。 触发：/req-plan、/实施计划、"帮我制定实施计划"、"根据需求生成开发计划"、"create implementation plan"。 不适用：需求未定（先 req-review）、纯调研/分析任务（不需要编码）、技术方案之外的验收测试（用 req-verify）。
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Glob, Grep, Bash, Edit

name: req-prd

description: 需求澄清技能，用于生成规范化的需求文档。通过 /req（标准版）或 /req --simple（简化版）命令触发。 自动引导用户从草稿目录或文字描述生成符合 AICoding 范式的 REQ 文档，包含用户故事、目标用户、需求背景、功能详细说明、本期边界（本期范围/本期不做）、验收标准等章节。 使用场景：编写需求文档、创建 PRD、需求澄清、从草稿整理需求、需求规格说明、/req 命令调用。当用户提到"需求文档"、"REQ"、"需求澄清"、"/req"时使用此技能。 重要：必须用户显式提供草稿目录或文字描述，禁止自动扫描仓库。

name: requirement-clarify
description: 需求澄清与转运——澄清框架四问产出《需求确认单》，客户显式确认后注入 ai-pm V3 研发流水线，状态回传、交付同步与回访的全闭环。

name: requirement-collection
description: Collect, clarify, and structure a development requirement before planning begins. Works interactively with the user — developer or non-developer — one question at a time. The user can skip any question; the agent will make a reasonable assumption and state it clearly.

name: requirement-collection
description: 读取 Tower 任务并按用户意图执行快速分析或确定性完整收集。用户提供 Tower 链接、要求分析 Bug、快速梳理需求、收集 Tower/蓝湖/Eolink 来源或生成 docs/tower 来源资料时使用。完整收集只调用统一脚本写来源文件，成功后默认自动转入 requirement-analysis；用户明确只收集时停止。不分析代码、不执行开发。

name: requirement-communication-assistant
description: 招聘需求沟通助手Skill（仅服务社招场景）。把三个环节①真实需求识别（含详细/快速两种模式）、②人才画像生成（含软素质胜任力模型）、③JD生成串成一条链路，基于同一个共享上下文文件推进，支持从任意环节进入、断点续跑、自动校验前置条件。环节①支持详细模式（多轮挖掘+6项识别方法，10-15轮）和快速模式（4问一次性回完，3-5轮搞定），用户可主动选择。环节②基于素质词典（5大类25项）自动推荐6-9项岗位软素质+4项集团价值观生成完整胜任力模型，用于后续面试出题设计；四层画像只保留硬技能/背景/经验类内容。环节③基于画像+胜任力模型生成可直接发布给候选人的 JD。触发词：我有一个招聘需求、有个新需求、帮我分析一个岗位、新开了一个HC、要招一个、招人需求、招聘需求分析、识别需求、生成画像、需求沟通、生成JD、写JD、岗位描述、快速生成画像、我赶时间。

name: requirement-comparison-reporter
description: Compares old and new requirement documents, analyzes code repository impact, and generates detailed modification plans. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Compare requirement versions and identify changes, (2) Map requirement changes to code components, (3) Identify components to modify, delete, or add, (4) Analyze dependencies and integration points, (5) Assess test impact, (6) Generate comprehensive modification plans in Markdown format. Supports text/Markdown requirements and analyzes feature-level, functional, and API changes.

name: requirement-compliance-review
description: Compare a user/customer requirement against a patch's reconstructed implemented behavior and the current-system baseline. Use to determine whether development is correct, complete, over-scoped, or likely to regress unrelated behavior.

name: requirement-comprehension-engine
description: Advanced requirement comprehension and skill orchestration engine. Analyzes complex/multi-step user requests, determines which skills to invoke and in what order, builds task decomposition trees. Delegates memory management to complex-memory-manager and self-iteration to self-iteration-engine for cross-skill consistency. Triggers: multi-intent requests, ambiguous instructions, requests spanning multiple skill domains, structured requirement analysis.

name: requirement-confirmation
description: Use when SA/PM gives an ambiguous verbal requirement, adds a follow-up adjustment, or the user records their own natural-language understanding. Turn it into a versioned reviewable requirement-confirmation package: preserve original requirement snapshots and Requirement Deltas, separate interpretation from fact, trace existing code for modifications or propose evidence-backed new scope, list ambiguities and acceptance criteria, default to Markdown without UI or DOCX with UI, and provide factual SA/PM review fields. Trigger for 需求確認、需求釐清、口頭需求、我理解的需求、追加需求、追加調整、需求補充、需求變更、SA/PM需求覆核、需求確認文件。

name: requirement-conflict-detection
description: Use this skill when multiple requirement, policy, contract, or acceptance sources may contain mutually exclusive rules or constraints; triggers include requirement conflict detection, conflicting requirements, and mutually exclusive requirements.

name: requirement-conflict-detection
description: Use this skill when multiple requirement, policy, contract, or acceptance sources may contain mutually exclusive rules or constraints; triggers include 需求冲突检测, requirement conflict detection, and conflicting requirements.

name: requirement-consistency-analysis
description: Use this skill when multiple requirement artifacts may disagree on terminology, identifiers, formats, states, rules, or behavior; triggers include requirement consistency, cross-document consistency, and consistency analysis.

name: requirement-consistency-analysis
description: Use this skill when multiple requirement artifacts may disagree on terminology, identifiers, formats, states, rules, or behavior; triggers include 需求一致性分析, requirement consistency, and cross-document consistency.

name: requirement-consistency-check
description: Detect inconsistencies, ambiguity, hidden reversible decisions and scope gaps in a requirement BEFORE any analysis or implementation, and force a user clarification when a finding is blocking. Use this skill as the FIRST step of Kuraka Phase 1 (before analyze-requirement / gap-analysis) for every ticket, and again whenever the user expands scope mid-cycle ('ahora también X', 'te faltó Y', 'hay algo más'). Triggers: any new requirement, fragmented/incremental asks, migration/refactor/externalize/encrypt/cleanup requests, or contradictory instructions. Invokable by po-analyst, amauta, architect…

name: requirement-consolidation-and-resolution
description: Turn a repository-wide pile of requirement candidates into a settled requirement set — grouped by business capability rather than by source layout, deduplicated across the whole repository, freed of implementation leakage, with every conflict decided and every candidate given a disposition. Use between requirement synthesis and requirement validation, whenever candidates were produced independently by more than one pass over the code.

name: requirement-context
description: 當使用者明確要求盤點需求上下文，或要求從專案文件、程式碼與資料庫查找需求相關背景資訊時使用。

name: requirement-contract
description: 現在の仕事について、調査や判断によって既に確定した、後続の行動を拘束する内容を、 意味を追加・変更せず外部ファイルへ固定するときに使う。 依頼の解釈、対象の調査、設計判断、未決事項の決定には使わない。

name: requirement-convergence
description: Separates the outcome a change must produce from the requirements proposed to reach it, records what the user excluded, and bands cost from decision-relevant repository evidence. Use when a requirement enters a workflow, before design begins.

name: requirement-convergence
description: 変更が生むべき成果と、そこへ至るために提案された要件を切り分け、ユーザーが除外したものを記録し、構造からコストをおおまかな区分で見積もる。要件がワークフローに入った時点、設計を始める前、または「どこまでやるか/スコープ外は何か/やる価値があるか」が言及された時に使用。

name: requirement-convergence
description: Separates the outcome a change must produce from the requirements proposed to reach it, records what the user excluded, and bands cost from structure. Use when a requirement enters a workflow, before design begins, or when "how far do we go/what's out of scope/is this worth it" is mentioned.

name: requirement-convergence
description: 将变更必须产生的结果与为达成该结果而提出的需求区分开来，记录用户明确排除的内容，并根据结构对成本进行分级评估。当需求进入某个工作流时、设计开始之前，或提到“做到什么程度/范围外是什么/是否值得做”时使用。

name: requirement-convergence
description: Converges future-state requirements around outcome, exclusions, and rough cost. Use when users ask 'do we need this?', 'how far should we go?', or request a feature or scope change.

name: requirement-convergence
description: Separates the outcome a change must produce from the requirements proposed to reach it, records what the user excluded, bands cost from structure, then turns the converged scope into verifiable AC-NNN acceptance criteria (scenario, action, expected result, must-not, verification method, priority), as a Quick Capture, a Full Acceptance Brief or a review of an existing spec. Use when a requirement enters a workflow, before design begins; when a user asks to clarify a feature, define acceptance criteria, make a complex request testable, de-risk a security, data, migration or integration change,…

name: requirement-coverage-checker
description: Verify that design documents, code implementations, and tests fully cover all specified requirements. Use this skill when validating requirement traceability, conducting design reviews, assessing implementation completeness, checking test coverage against requirements, performing compliance audits, or identifying missing functionality. Produces coverage reports showing which requirements are satisfied, partially satisfied, or missing.

name: requirement-decompose
description: Decompose customer RFP materials into pages, interactions, and acceptance criteria for Near delivery loop.

name: requirement-decomposition
description: 将模糊需求转化为可执行任务的三层框架（澄清→拆解→验证）。适用于用户提出模糊需求、需要拆解为具体开发任务时使用。

name: requirement-definition
description: Requirement Definition ceremony. Spawns a single requirements-analyst to elicit requirements through natural-language dialogue and mandatory benchmark web-search research, producing a requirements document, a benchmark findings document, and the initial Product Backlog.

name: requirement-definition
description: 用需求树和一个关键问题收敛不可再删除的需求核心。用户要求澄清需求、识别真正目标，或材料包含模糊想法、现成方案、目标冲突、范围扩张和未确认假设时使用；停在需求层。

name: requirement-definition
description: AI-DLC Inception Phase Stage 1: やりたいことを明確化し要件定義書を作成する。新機能や改修の開始時に使用。

name: requirement-definition
description: Author a UCD tender's frozen-package requirement content (stage A). Catalogue the Inbox references, select the SP sections, assemble each by reference at clause granularity plus an own-layer of net-new clauses, write the RP Description of the Works, instantiate the Project Classification Listing, and propose the recommended drawing set. Use after procurement-scaffold, when writing the specification / works requirements for a job, or "draft the spec for <job>".

name: requirement-delivery
description: 接到新需求、要从需求快速走到可交付时使用。先理清再动手,高效落地。

name: requirement-detector
description: 探测用户的写作规范需求并加载对应文档。当用户提到AI味重、去AI味、自然、爽文、快节奏、爽点、无毒点、不降智、严肃文学、有深度、强情绪、打动人、甜文、撒糖、虐文、虐心、BE等关键词时自动激活。适用于讨论写作要求、AI去味方法、节奏控制、情感表达时使用。

name: requirement-detector
description: Detects and enforces specific plot or content requirements (e.g., fast-paced, high emotion).

name: requirement-discovery
description: MUST use before brainstorming, visual companion, Pencil/Figma, or implementation when a user gives a rough product, feature, app, website, landing page, brand site, front-end design draft, or "do not develop yet" goal. Draft the first structured requirement contract and fixed workspace before design or implementation.

name: requirement-discovery
description: Elicit, clarify, and document product requirements from stakeholders. Transforms vague needs into actionable, unambiguous requirements.

name: requirement-discovery
description: Use esta skill quando uma solicitação estiver vaga, incompleta ou ambígua e for necessário transformar a ideia em requisito, escopo, critérios de aceite, validações e pendências antes da implementação.

name: requirement-doc
description: 需求文档（PRD）生成 Skill（产品经理角色）。将产品灵感或需求分析结果转化为结构化的 PRD 文档，并生成低保真 HTML 原型图（wireframe），用于快速验证信息架构和交互逻辑。高保真原型由 `prototype-design` Skill（设计师角色）负责。参考 references 目录中的标准模板生成。触发条件：(1) 生成需求文档/PRD，(2) 将灵感转化为需求，(3) 需要产品需求文档模板，(4) 整理需求为正式文档，(5) 撰写产品方案，(6) 需求规格说明书，(7) 生成原型图/wireframe/线框图。

name: requirement-doc
description: 要件定義書（02-requirement.md）を、要求定義書（01-request.md）を入力に1本のMarkdownへ書き起こす。「誰の・どんな課題を・なぜ解決するか」を「何を作るか」へ翻訳し、機能一覧 / 各機能の要件（事前条件・正常フロー・例外・受入基準） / スコープ（Scope1-3・Out of Scope） / 非機能要件 の4章で定義する。機能一覧と各機能の要件はClaudeが先に書き切ってからユーザーと一緒に見て直し、スコープと非機能要件は質問して決める。要求定義が済んで実装に入る前、作るものの範囲と受入基準を確定させたいときに使う。要求定義書が存在することが前提（無ければ先にrequest-docで作る）。画面構成・モック・テーブル定義・APIエンドポイントには踏み込まない（それは仕様書以降の仕事）。既にある要件定義書の点検・レビューはこのスキルではなく requirement-doc-review が担う。

name: requirement-doc-review
description: 既にある要件定義書（02-requirement.md）を点検し、不足を洗い出して埋める。文書全体に観点を当て、章や項目の欠落・要求定義（01）とのトレーサビリティ・機能一覧と各機能の要件のずれ・受入基準が検証可能か・スコープの過不足・仕様やDB設計の混入・未確定の残りを見る。不足があればユーザーに判断を仰ぎながら直し、無ければ「不足のない文書が既にある」と伝えて終わる。要件定義書を書き上げた直後の最終点検にも、他人が書いた要件定義書のレビューにも、仕様書へ進む前の確認にも使う。新規に書き起こす用途では使わない（それは requirement-doc）。

name: requirement-doc-store
description: 需求相关文档的通用存储规范：按文档类型自动决定落盘路径，确保各 skill 产出统一归位到需求目录下的正确子目录。触发：任何 skill 生成需求相关文档需要落盘时（设计文档、数据流图、验证/审查/实现报告等）。

name: requirement-doc-template
description: Create, supplement, review, or rewrite Chinese product/business requirement documents in the user's H5-example Word structure and black-and-white style. Use for 需求文档/需求说明书/PRD work that requires function-specific business sections, one channel table, diagrams selected by requirement scale and explanatory need, a degradation plan, a semantically correct 21-row safety baseline, acceptance-ready content, and final DOCX validation.

name: requirement-doc-writer
description: 撰写 artifacts/requirement.md（阶段 2 产出物），严格执行"刨根问底"——每条关键信息必须有来源、或标记待确认/待补充。

name: requirement-doc-writer
description: 写 PRD / 需求文档 / 产品需求文档 / 需求说明 / user story 文档 / 验收标准文档 / 产品需求正文 —— 在 lifecycle 判定 PRD Ready 之后，把已关闭的需求组装成人读的 PRD。Skip 需求实质不清 → requirement-intent；缺现状事实 → requirement-baseline；范围/版本切片/开放决策未关闭 → requirement-scope；Agent/Machine 技术规格 → llm-inference-integration；其评测与测试层 → testing-strategy；只是润色措辞 → tighten-doc；写完 PRD 还要接着往下做的多阶段研发交付·实现/发布计划 → product-rd-workflow。

name: requirement-docs

name: requirement-document-generator
description: 客户需求智能整理与文档生成专家。从沟通记录（飞书文档、妙记、会议纪要等）中提取、分析并整理成结构化的需求文档，自动生成飞书文档。触发场景：(1) 用户需要整理客户需求文档 (2) 需要将会议纪要转换为需求文档 (3) 需要从沟通记录提取关键需求 (4) 需要生成项目需求说明书 (5) 需要创建业务需求文档 (BRD) 或产品需求文档 (PRD)

name: requirement-drift

Reports which business rules are now stale and which tests must be re-run. Use when user says "/requirement-drift SCRUM-255", "did the AC change", "what changed since last run", "do we need to retest", "new build deployed", or at the start of any regression cycle on an Epic tested before.

name: requirement-driven-selection
description: Evaluates technology candidates against measurable project requirements using weighted decision matrices, evidence-based validation, and ADR documentation to select the optimal framework or tool for a given context.

name: requirement-elicitation
description: 通过协作对话挖出用户真实业务痛点、在动手实现前先把需求搞对的心智——本仓 dev 流的需求发现闸（取代 superpowers:brainstorming，让 cc-master 的 dev meta-skill 自洽不外依赖）。Use when: 开始本仓任何 feature / skill / 行为改动之前（动第一下实现之前，无论请求看起来多简单）；请求以一个猜出来的方案形态到来而底层问题没说出口（"加个按钮" / "给我做个 X"）；要建模或动手却说不清真实需求、指不出一个它真在疼的具体实例；为一个新问题空间和用户共创词汇；一个请求捆了多个独立子系统、动手前要先拆；作为 master orchestrator 跑前台需求发现对话（挖需求是指挥自己的活，绝不外包）。Do NOT use: 已确认需求后写一个 skill 的 body → cc-master-skillsmith；判要不要建 skill / 放哪 / 会不会重叠 → curating-skill-portfolios；度量一个已写好的 skill → grounding-skill-evals；写 workflow 脚本怎么 parallel/pipeline → authoring-workflows；驱动一个已批准的 goal 到完成（编排执行 loop）→ master-orchestrator-guid…

name: requirement-elicitation
description: Use when gathering project requirements, or when a user says 'help me define requirements' or 'figure out what to build' - adaptive wizard covering functional, nonfunctional, constraints, and edge cases with domain-specific questions for web apps, APIs, CLIs, mobile, and data pipelines

name: requirement-elicitation

Use when the user wants to gather requirements, write a BRD, document business rules, says "what are the requirements", "help me write a BRD", "let's capture the business needs", "document the rules", or needs to formalize what the business wants before user stories are written.

name: requirement-elicitation
description: Requirement elicitation workflow for collecting, reconciling, and structuring evidence before requirement baseline writing. Use when requirement inputs are incomplete and teams need high-confidence evidence gathering; do not use for final canonical requirement synthesis.

name: requirement-elicitation-canvas

name: requirement-engineering

name: requirement-engineering
description: 需求工程 — 在任何创造性工作之前使用。通过协作对话收集需求、系统性验证、产出可作为设计和开发基准的需求文档。

name: requirement-engineering
description: Use for EPIC lifecycle work, requirement drift detection, functional and non-functional requirement classification, architecture impact analysis, requirement traceability, constraint management, assumption tracking, and continuous comparison between implementation and EPIC assumptions.

name: requirement-engineering
description: Use when a project's requirements need writing down or cleaning up — "requirements", "user stories", "acceptance criteria", "release stages", "non-functional requirements", or the German "Anforderungen", "Ausbaustufen", "Akzeptanzkriterien", "Abnahmekriterien"; when a concept for a game, feature or event exists only as prose; when a library or service has unclear scope; when a running system was never documented; or when someone asks about EARS or MoSCoW. Works for internal wiki-documented projects, public open-source repos and third-party projects alike. Not for prioritizing issues, not for…

name: requirement-enhancer
description: Iteratively enhance user requirements into clear, complete, actionable specifications through analysis and clarification. Use when: (1) Users provide initial requirements that need refinement, (2) Requirements are vague, incomplete, or ambiguous, (3) Creating formal specifications from informal descriptions, (4) Identifying missing constraints, edge cases, or acceptance criteria, (5) Clarifying assumptions and implicit dependencies, or (6) Preparing requirements for design, implementation, or verification. Operates interactively: analyze → ask clarifying questions → refine based on responses.

name: requirement-enhancer
description: Improve the quality, completeness, and testability of software requirements by applying quality attributes analysis, enhancement patterns, acceptance.

name: requirement-enrichment
description: Phrases the pipeline's clarification questions as plain-language two-layer question objects. Use when the label step rated the request vague or okay, unlocked a question budget, and the touched area is grounded.

name: requirement-eval
description: 评估「这个需求值不值得做」，按 KANO 定位 + RICE 打分自动出一份评估初稿和建议。 触发词：这个需求值得做吗、要不要做这个、评估一下这个需求、值不值得做、需求评估、requirement-eval、帮我判断这个需求优先级。 产出是初稿建议，不是最终决策。产品级信息（覆盖端/数据现状/知识库）读产品上下文，与 prd-writing 共享、不重复访谈。

name: requirement-evidence
description: 把访谈、工单、销售反馈、数据与功能请求综合为可追溯的问题主题、证据账本和待验证假设。用于需求发现、批量反馈分析、需求澄清或客户诉求评估；不得把转述、推断或模拟反馈冒充真实用户证据。

name: requirement-executor

description: Revisión adversarial de código para cualquier repo de Marbust. OBLIGATORIA en dos momentos — sobre tu propio diff antes de abrir un PR, y al revisar el PR de otra persona (incluido el QA de Codex o Claude). También lleva el PR la última milla — estado vivo del PR, verificación sobre su HEAD, pase de impacto en todo el repo, ciclo de revisión hasta limpio (incluido Greptile), smoke de UI con capturas reales y readiness de merge con freno antes de producción. Busca lo que un revisor exigente encontraría (huecos entre las pruebas, permisos por rol en la capa equivocada, acceso a datos ajenos por…

name: revisar-commits
description: Revisa objetos GeneXus antes de commitear a GXserver, buscando bugs tanto en los cambios como en el codigo preexistente del objeto. Extrae los diffs reales y el fuente completo leyendo la base SQL de la KB, sin lockearla y con el IDE abierto. Acepta una captura de pantalla de la grilla Pending Commits, una lista de nombres, o nada (usa la ultima sesion de trabajo). Usar cuando pidan "BWX revisar commits", revisar lo que van a subir, buscar bugs en un procedure, o ver el diff de un objeto GeneXus.

name: revisar-contrato
description: Revisar um contrato com base no playbook de negociacao da organizacao -- identifica desvios, gera sugestoes de redline e fornece analise de impacto comercial. Use ao revisar contratos de fornecedores ou clientes, quando precisar de analise clausula por clausula contra posicoes-padrao, ou ao preparar estrategia de negociacao com redlines priorizados e posicoes de fallback.

name: revisar-copy-lp
description: Audita copy de uma seção da LP contra checklist CRO (hook force, benefícios concretos, CTA único, prova social, objeções respondidas, leitura 5ª série, gatilhos psicológicos). Use SEMPRE que o aluno disser "revisar copy", "auditar LP", "minha copy tá boa?", "checar conversão da copy", "auditoria de copy", "review copy LP".

name: revisar-cpf
description: revisa validação de CPF — chama via /revisar-cpf

name: revisar-datos-personales-carlos-dominguez-faber
description: Audita un proyecto de software frente a la Ley 21.719 de proteccion de datos personales de Chile. Levanta el inventario de datos personales que trata el sistema, revisa diez puntos de cumplimiento con evidencia de archivo y linea, y entrega un reporte que separa lo verificado de lo que no se pudo comprobar. Usar cuando alguien pida revisar cumplimiento, privacidad, proteccion de datos, GDPR, RGPD, 21.719, minimizacion, consentimiento, derecho de supresion o portabilidad en un repositorio.

name: revisar-dependencias-cve
description: Verifica CVEs em package.json, lockfile e Dockerfiles e inspeciona scripts postinstall de novas dependências. Use quando o dev-security ou o dev-devops vai avaliar o risco de dependências.

name: revisar-ders
description: Revisa o Documento de Especificação de Requisitos de Software (DERS) de uma tarefa Monday pelo título idêntico. Avalia coesão RF/UC/CA, Cenário, suficiência do delta e se cada caminho novo ou alterado é testável por CA e pelas referências normativas nomeadas, sem implementação e sem consultar o codebase. Não julga o título do item contra o documento. Use com /revisar-ders ou quando o usuário pedir para revisar DERS, especificação de requisitos ou o documento da tarefa no Monday.

name: revisar-desarrollo
description: Revisión final de un desarrollo ya terminado y validado manualmente en ui-kit. Evalúa el riesgo del cambio y según eso revisa convenciones, API pública, lint, pruebas, documentación, rendimiento, accesibilidad y posibles fallos. Úsala solo cuando el usuario la pida explícitamente (por ejemplo "revisa el desarrollo" o "/revisar-desarrollo"), no durante el desarrollo.

name: revisar-desempenho
description: Analisa as métricas dos vídeos publicados em perfis/<perfil>/controle/testes.csv, diagnostica flops e decide entre manter, ajustar, dobrar ou abandonar cada linha de conteúdo. Use quando o usuário trouxer números do YouTube Studio, TikTok ou Instagram.

name: revisar-diff
description: Revisa o diff atual (git) procurando bug, segredo vazado e teste faltando, e responde em PT-BR com achados por severidade. Use quando o aluno pedir "revisa meu código", "revisar diff" ou antes de um commit.
allowed_tools: Bash(git diff *) Bash(git status *) Read Grep

name: revisar-diff
description: Review do diff atual contra as armadilhas críticas do NextAI + TypeScript check

name: revisar-docs
description: Audita la coherencia de la documentación del repo (CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs canónicos y guías) contra el estado real del código y el árbol de archivos. Detecta rutas muertas, estados de transición ya superados y versiones descuadradas. Úsalo tras cualquier cambio estructural, antes de cerrar un slice, o cuando se sospeche deriva documental.

name: revisar-dossie
description: Use ao ler o dossiê de comportamento do Flow (docs/dossie/) — para julgar o que um branch mudou no comportamento do app antes do merge, ou para fazer uma varredura larga procurando o implausível.

name: revisar-edicao
description: Checklist de revisão de uma edição (EDL e vídeo renderizado) antes de entregar ao usuário. Use antes de cada render/entrega ou quando ele pedir "revisa".

name: revisar-financas
description: Use essa habilidade sempre que for ver o caixa, o lucro, a DRE, a receita bruta ou o faturamento de um período, o fluxo de caixa, o diagnóstico, a auditoria ou o preço de venda, mesmo sem dizer revisar. NÃO use para registrar a venda ou o gasto, mover o estoque, planejar o mês, nem projetar o caixa das feiras.

name: revisar-flashcards
description: Audita flashcards contra as 20 regras de Wozniak e os princípios de Matuschak — linter determinístico (lista, sim/não, vazamento, prolixidade, SQL sem esquema, termos fora do vocabulário, interferência, órfãos) mais julgamento com exemplos rotulados, checagem de fatos contra a fonte e execução de código — e devolve veredito pass/flag/reject com correção. Use para revisar cards recém-gerados (sempre por um revisor que não os escreveu), auditar um deck Anki existente (.apkg) ou quando o aluno disser que um card "está ruim", "vive errando" ou é um leech.

name: revisar-frontend
description: Revisa código React e TypeScript quanto a padrões, performance e acessibilidade. Use quando o dev-frontend vai autorrevisar o código antes do PR.

name: revisar-funil
description: Checa a saúde do funil de vendas etapa por etapa - cobertura da meta, negócios envelhecendo, conversão e negócios em risco - a partir dos dados do CRM. Use quando a pessoa pedir "revisa meu funil", "como está meu pipeline", "onde meu funil está travado", "revisão semanal do funil", "em quais negócios foco esta semana", "tem negócio parado?", "quais negócios estão com data vencida", "quais dependem de uma pessoa só", "minha cobertura bate com a meta?", "review my pipeline".

name: revisar-gdd
description: Review game design readiness. Use when pedir revisar GDD, achar contradições entre mecânicas e fases, verificar direção audiovisual ou decidir se um incremento pode entrar em produção, com achados e critérios rastreáveis.

name: revisar-habilidade
description: Revisa uma skill já escrita e sinaliza descrição vaga, gatilho faltando ou problema de estrutura. Usada quando a pessoa quer ver o risco de disparar demais ou de menos, ou sugerir casos a partir do propósito, mesmo sem dizer revisar. NÃO serve para criar a primeira versão, executar o teste e editar a skill, só medir tamanho, nem gravar a página no Notion.

name: revisar-interface
description: Audita a implementação de UI contra guardrails de acessibilidade WCAG 2.1 AA, tipografia e performance visual, em modo report ou fix. Use quando o dev-ui-ux ou o tech-lead vai validar a UI implementada.

name: revisar-interfaz
description: Revisión de solo lectura de un cambio de interfaz en Mendoza Transparente (rama, cambios sin commitear o PR) contra las reglas de diseño, celular, accesibilidad, textos y movimiento. Encuentra lo que el cambio rompió, empeoró o dejó a medias, y devuelve una tabla con veredicto. Cargar antes de commitear un cambio de interfaz grande, al integrar lo que hizo un subagente en apps/web o packages/ui, o cuando piden "revisá esto".

name: revisar-issue
description: Revisar, normalizar e reescrever issues do GitHub como especificacoes claras, testaveis e prontas para implementacao, inclusive revisao de issue especifica ou em lote, melhoria de criterios de aceite e reconciliacao com README/docs/arquitetura/ADR/API/runbooks quando houver conflito ou duplicidade de fonte canonica. Sob `entregar-issue`, executar somente quando o readiness gate falhar, corrigir apenas pontos bloqueantes, reutilizar fontes e registro documental, versionar mudancas materiais e retornar resultado estruturado; nao implementar codigo nem criar entrega paralela.

name: revisar-linkedin
description: Review LinkedIn positioning. Use quando pedir para reescrever headline, Sobre, experiências, destaques ou capa do LinkedIn, ou retomar uma revisão anterior do perfil profissional. Não pressupõe publicação nem vaga ativa.

name: revisar-logs
description: Lee los logs reales de CloudWatch de un Lambda antes de diagnosticar nada. Úsala siempre que un servicio desplegado falle, en vez de inferir la causa desde el código.
allowed_tools: Bash(aws logs *), Bash(aws lambda *), Bash(aws cloudwatch *), Bash(python3 *)

name: revisar-memoria-cuentas
description: Úsala cuando el auditor pida revisar la memoria de unas cuentas anuales, comprobar que contiene la información obligatoria, detectar omisiones o contrastarla con el PGC, el PGC PYMES, las NOFCAC o una adaptación sectorial del PGC, a partir de las cuentas aportadas como PDF, DOCX o texto. Produce un informe de revisión en el chat con el estado de cada requisito, los cruces básicos con el balance y la cuenta de pérdidas y ganancias, y la fuente oficial de cada requisito. No emite opinión de auditoría.

name: revisar-meu-suporte
description: Receba um relatório estruturado de como o suporte está indo. Um resumo semanal que cobre todas as áreas com volume, principais temas, promessas atrasadas e alertas de cancelamento abertos. Um resumo da central de ajuda que mostra os temas dos tickets, a velocidade dos pedidos, e o artigo mais útil para escrever a seguir. Ou uma revisão por conta que mapeia vitórias, pedidos entregues, fricções em aberto, e próximos passos, para você chegar preparado na ligação.

name: revisar-mi-bandeja-de-entrada
description: Obtén un vistazo rápido de tu bandeja de soporte. Elige lo que necesitas: un resumen matutino que clasifica los 5 a 10 tickets que realmente necesitan tu atención hoy, una revisión de vencidos que marca todo lo que está por incumplir los tiempos de respuesta o que ya está atrasado, o un barrido de hilos olvidados que detecta las conversaciones que dejaste de lado. Yo reviso, clasifico y te digo por dónde empezar.

name: revisar-mi-marketing
description: Te doy un diagnóstico real de cómo está funcionando tu marketing. Elige lo que necesitas: un análisis de embudo que señala la mayor fuga con experimentos para probar, un análisis de brechas de contenido frente a un competidor, o un resumen semanal de todo lo que entregué y lo que falta. Números y próximos pasos, no un panel de control.

name: revisar-mi-nexo-de-impuesto-sobre-ventas
description: Descubre dónde debes impuesto sobre ventas. Sumo los ingresos y el número de transacciones por estado de EE. UU. desde Stripe (o QuickBooks / Xero / facturas como respaldo), comparo los totales de cada estado contra su umbral de nexo económico para el trimestre y los últimos 12 meses, identifico el mes exacto en que cada estado cruzado se activó, y marco los estados con nexo físico (empleados W-2, oficinas, inventario / FBA). Clasifico la exposición de mayor a menor monto en dólares y señalo los estados más cercanos a cruzar el umbral como alertas tempranas. Yo preparo, tú te registras y remi…

name: revisar-mi-quema-de-caja-y-runway
description: Obtén el resumen de una página para fundadores: efectivo disponible, quema neta de los últimos 3 y 6 meses, meses de runway, una tabla de sensibilidad de ±20%, y los 3 principales factores de costo detrás de la quema. Los saldos de efectivo provienen de QuickBooks / Xero / tu feed bancario cuando está conectado, o del estado de cuenta más reciente en caso contrario. Cada número cita su fuente: saldo bancario con marca de tiempo, línea del estado de resultados con la ruta del archivo, ids de asientos contables en los factores de costo. Yo muestro los números y tú decides dónde recortar.

name: revisar-mi-soporte
description: Obtén un reporte estructurado de cómo va el soporte. Un resumen semanal que cubre todas las áreas con volumen, temas principales, promesas vencidas y alertas de cancelación abiertas. Un resumen del centro de ayuda que muestra los temas de los tickets, la velocidad de solicitudes, y el artículo más útil para escribir a continuación. O una revisión por cuenta que mapea logros, solicitudes entregadas, fricción abierta, y próximos pasos, para que llegues a la llamada preparado.

name: revisar-migracao
description: Ritual de migração de banco deste projeto — auditar, ensaiar em dois níveis, aplicar com conferência que falha sozinha, medir antes e depois, registrar no cabeçalho. Use ao escrever, revisar ou aplicar qualquer arquivo em supabase/migrations/, e antes de qualquer mudança de schema, grant, política de RLS ou privilégio.

name: revisar-migracion
description: Procedimiento previo a escribir cualquier migración de FlowSync. Mira el esquema real por el MCP, cuenta las filas afectadas, dice en qué rama cae, escribe el down antes que el up y prueba ida, vuelta e ida en la base de pruebas. Usar antes de crear o modificar un fichero de backend/database/migrations/.

name: revisar-minhas-provisoes
description: Use quando disser 'liste nossas provisões ativas' / 'atualize o registro de provisões' / 'alguma provisão está vencida?' / 'quais lançamentos de reversão estão pendentes?'. Recalculo os saldos atuais de cada provisão ativa (aluguel antecipado, SaaS antecipado, receita diferida, PTO, folha de pagamento provisionada, juros provisionados), sinalizo os itens vencidos, e mostro os candidatos a lançamentos de reversão. Leio `accruals.json` + `journal-entries.json` + o plano de contas; reescrevo `accruals/register.md` e atualizo ou crio `accruals.json`.

name: revisar-mis-devengos
description: Úsalo cuando digas 'lista nuestros devengos activos' / 'actualiza el registro de devengos' / '¿hay devengos vencidos?' / '¿qué asientos de reversión están pendientes?'. Recalculo los saldos actuales de cada devengo activo (renta prepagada, SaaS prepagado, ingresos diferidos, PTO, nómina devengada, intereses devengados), marco las partidas vencidas, y muestro los candidatos a asientos de reversión. Leo `accruals.json` + `journal-entries.json` + el plan de cuentas; reescribo `accruals/register.md` y actualizo o creo `accruals.json`.

name: revisar-mis-ventas
description: Obtén un diagnóstico real de cómo va tu proceso de ventas. Elige lo que necesitas: un resumen de lunes en todos los frentes, una síntesis entre llamadas con ajustes al playbook, una lectura de patrones de ganados y perdidos, un análisis profundo de una llamada de descubrimiento específica, o una foto del pipeline con la etapa que más se filtra. Cada lectura termina con una acción concreta a seguir, no con un dashboard.

name: revisar-mobile
description: Revisa código React Native antes do PR quanto a performance, acessibilidade, padrões e comportamento cross-platform. Use quando o dev-mobile ou o tech-lead vai revisar um PR mobile.

name: revisar-mr
description: Revisa merge requests do Cérebro (Yii2) e do migrations-sgi seguindo os padrões do time. Funciona com link/!id do MR (lê e comenta no GitLab pelo Chrome) ou sem link, dentro do repositório (diff local da branch atual contra develop/master, relatório no chat). Use quando pedirem "revisar mr", "revisa esse merge", "code review do cérebro" ou rodarem /revisar-mr.

name: revisar-mudanca
description: Roda a revisão completa da branch do controle-financeiro antes do PR — gates mecânicos (build, testes, guardrail, varredura de secrets e de dados) e os agentes revisores pertinentes ao diff. Use quando a implementação está pronta, antes de abrir-pr.

name: revisar-naturalidade
description: Review editorial drafts. Use when o usuário pedir para revisar a naturalidade, deixar mais humano, tirar cara de IA, evitar texto genérico ou preservar a própria voz em artigos, posts e outras comunicações.

name: revisar-naturalidade
description: Use quando o usuário pedir para revisar a naturalidade de um rascunho, deixar o texto mais humano, tirar cara de IA ou preservar sua voz em artigos, posts e outras comunicações.

name: revisar-negocio
description: Análise profunda de um negócio - nota de saúde ajustada pelos sinais reais, riscos, o que falta na qualificação e as próximas ações recomendadas. Use quando a pessoa pedir "revisa o negócio do [cliente]", "esse negócio vai fechar?", "qual o risco do [negócio]", "análise da oportunidade [X]", "deal review", "is [opp] going to close".

name: revisar-oportunidade
description: Revisa o conteúdo, o corpo e as anotações de uma edição que já existe, preserva o bloco de anotações e o callout e passa cada fato para a propriedade certa. Usada quando a pessoa pede para revisar, limpar, enriquecer, consolidar, reorganizar ou atualizar uma edição. NÃO serve para cadastrar a edição, o grupo ou a programação, nem para inscrever ou criar a tarefa.

name: revisar-orcamento
description: Compara o Orçamento de um ciclo com o gasto/receita real em Lançamentos e aponta categorias estouradas. Acione quando o usuário pedir revisão de orçamento, comparação orçado x realizado, ou "estourei o orçamento" na raiz financeira do vault.

name: revisar-peca
description: Revisa qualquer peça já redigida linha por linha via auditoria adversarial — confere prova documental e testemunhal contra os documentos do caso, valida toda base jurídica com as skills de pesquisa, audita a honestidade dos argumentos e aponta as fragilidades que o adversário exploraria. Produz um relatório de revisão acionável.

name: revisar-peca-juridica
description: Audita petições e documentos jurídicos brasileiros antes do protocolo, verificando fatos, estrutura, fundamentos, citações, pedidos, prazos, anexos, coerência e riscos.

name: revisar-pr
description: Use to review a PR/MR against the SDD standard — it checks process conformance: an approved spec for the change, each AC-N with a green test, no open SPEC_DEVIATION, ADRs for irreversible decisions, glossary/context-map updated, and the DoD met. Posts the result as a comment on the PR/MR via the GitHub/GitLab MCP (if connected). Complements the harness /code-review (which hunts for bugs). Trigger with /revisar-pr.

name: revisar-pr
description: Conduz um PR do repositório do começo ao fim — ler a issue e o diff, decidir o que é nosso e o que volta para o autor, cobrir o que falta de teste, medir e integrar na main. Use ao dizer "vamos trabalhar no PR N", ao revisar contribuição de terceiro, ou ao retomar um ramo parado.

name: revisar-pr
description: Revisa un PR antes de mergearlo — lanza el agente revisor sobre su diff, comprueba CI y SonarCloud y resume si se puede mergear. Úsala con el número del PR (por ejemplo, /revisar-pr 152).

name: revisar-pr
description: Revisión independiente de una PR de DDD antes de que la fusione el propietario. Úsala cuando pidan revisar una PR o un diff. Quien construye no certifica: revisa con el diff y la especificación, en solo lectura.

name: revisar-pr
description: Review a PR diff against requirements and conventions, ranked findings. Use for revisar PR. Do NOT use for security review (revisar-seguranca-pr).

name: revisar-pr
description: Revisa um pull request no GitHub e posta um único review consolidado (evento COMMENT, com comentários inline), com evidência em cada achado e no máximo 3 rodadas. A rodada 1 é completa; as seguintes só conferem o ledger e bloqueante novo introduzido pela correção. Use quando o usuário disser "revisa esse PR", "revisa o pull request", "faz o code review", "code review desse PR", "julga esse PR", "/review", "revisa de novo", "roda o review de novo", "re-review". NÃO use para corrigir o código, responder comentário de review, nem diagnosticar ou consertar falha de CI.

name: revisar-pr
description: Revisa una o varias propuestas de cambio abiertas antes de fusionarlas, y avisa cuáles son seguras y cuáles no. Usala cuando el dueño diga "tengo PR para fusionar", "revisá las propuestas", "¿puedo mergear?" o pida el estado de las propuestas abiertas. Nunca fusiona: sólo revisa y aconseja.

name: revisar-pr
description: Revisa un PR de EngiMods contra los criterios de su historia, la Definition of Done y las reglas de AGENTS.md y docs/arquitectura.md, y entrega un veredicto con hallazgos concretos. Úsala cuando la persona pida "revisa el PR

name: revisar-pr
description: Revisa um PR (ou o conjunto de PRs irmãos de uma mudança) de um repositório da Oficina — roda as verificações locais na branch do PR, os contratos entre repos e os revisores especializados, e entrega um relatório. Use para "revisa o PR X", "dá uma olhada no PR do gateway", antes de aprovar ou mergear.

name: revisar-pr
description: Conduz a revisão técnica de um Pull Request com gates de qualidade, segurança, testes e DoD. Use quando o tech-lead vai revisar e aprovar um PR.

name: revisar-pr
description: Reviews a Codex PR against the issue and AGENTS.md

name: revisar-pr
description: Revisa una pull request de este repositorio cuando se pide revisarla o validarla. Comprueba los criterios de aceptación de la issue que cierra, las reglas de CLAUDE.md, el proceso de ramas y commits y la CI, y devuelve un informe con veredicto. No la uses para explicar código, para revisar cambios que todavía no están en una PR ni para resolver issues.
allowed_tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(git diff *), Bash(git log *), Bash(git branch --show-current), Bash(npx commitlint *), mcp__github__pull_request_read, mcp__github__list_pull_requests, mcp__github__issue_read, mcp__github__get_commit, mcp__github__get_file_contents, mcp__github__actions_list, mcp__github__act

name: revisar-prod
description: Revisar qué está pasando en producción de IaRadio leyendo los registros de Railway (solo lectura) — errores, chats lentos o cortados, fallas de servicios externos (Groq, Voyage, Meta, Anthropic), base de datos. Úsalo siempre que el usuario reporte algo raro en vivo ("no me llegó tu mensaje", "el bot no contesta", "tardó mucho", "salió un error", "no aparece en el Inbox"), después de un despliegue para confirmar que no hay errores nuevos, o antes de culpar al código de algo que podría ser un servicio externo.

name: revisar-projeto
description: Revisor jurídico de projeto (IA, SaaS, startup): mapeia lacunas em N1 Brasil (União e UFs), N2 país (EUA ou o mais coerente) e N3 mundo, a partir do código e do questionário. Usar quando pedirem revisão jurídica, compliance ou gaps legais de um projeto; exige revisão profissional.

name: revisar-proyectos
description: Comando de revisión semanal de proyectos. El agente project-manager audita los proyectos activos, pausados y finalizados, detecta bloqueos, fechas próximas e incoherencias, y propone prioridades y cambios de estado.

name: revisar-qualidade
description: Revisa tarefa ou código contra as regras de qualidade e as convenções; só reporta, não corrige. Usar ao pedir revisão, QA, review ou "confere se está certo".
allowed_tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash(git diff *), Bash(git status *)

name: revisar-responsive
description: Verificar un modulo o pagina en los 3 breakpoints (desktop, tablet, movil) con screenshots automaticos. Usar cuando se hacen cambios de layout o CSS y se necesita validar que todo se ve bien en todas las pantallas.

name: revisar-rf
description: Revisa um entregável de Requisitos Funcionais (RF) em Excel de qualquer projeto usando o MCP rf-engine. A parte mecânica (extrair, montar colunas, formatar, INJETAR a análise de volta na planilha, validar, versionar) é das tools; o julgamento (preencher as colunas por referência cruzada com a memória do projeto, com o project_id da sua memória) é do agente. Use SEMPRE que chegar uma PLANILHA (.xlsx/.csv) de requisitos para analisar/revisar antes de enviar ao cliente. NÃO use para documentos (.pdf/.docx/.pptx) — esses seguem o fluxo de análise de documento.

name: revisar-roteiro
description: Revisa criticamente o roteiro de uma viagem do Bora Viajar (ritmo dos dias, deslocamentos ilógicos, horários conflitantes, pontas soltas) e propõe correções concretas. Use quando o usuário pedir para revisar, criticar, checar ou melhorar um roteiro/itinerário.

name: revisar-schoice
description: Revisa un ejercicio SCHOICE .Rmd existente ejecutando los pasos 4-11 del workflow completo. Orquesta: retroalimentación, renderizado, arsenal, detractor, coherencias, diversidad, validar-icfes y aprobación. name: rfc6238

name: rfc6749
description: RFC 6749: The OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework. Defines the protocol for third-party application access to HTTP services on behalf of a resource owner, introducing authorization layers, access tokens, and refresh tokens. Replaces OAuth 1.0 (RFC 5849).

name: rfc7523
description: RFC 7523: JSON Web Token (JWT) Profile for OAuth 2.0 Client Authentication and Authorization Grants. Profiles the OAuth Assertion Framework (RFC 7521) to define (1) the jwt-bearer authorization grant for requesting an access token from an existing trust relationship without a user-approval step, and (2) JWT-based client authentication at the token endpoint via client_assertion. The basis for the private_key_jwt client authentication method. Use when implementing or validating signed JWT assertions for OAuth token requests, client_assertion_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-…
